== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The Players Committee explained that the original intent was for Imperials to be immune to Demotion. Its complete 8 March 2006 text replaces the prohibition on playing Demotion on an Imperial with ongoing immunity. The December remastered slip retains the revised effect in shorter phrasing.
